payload.explanation: Fresh activity read confirms the plan's diagnosis: business request session_240651e5417e is active waiting on transactionid, blocked by session_22323920c486 (pid 1499), which is idle in transaction after executing the same UPDATE inventory SET stock=stock-1 WHERE product_id=1 and holds the uncommitted row lock; no other blockers exist (other sessions block nothing). Policy confirms session_22323920c486 is eligible for rollback_session and the business request session has no allowed actions, so the plan respects the constraint of never touching the business request. Business view confirms the request is still pending with stock=100 (expected 99), so the incident is unresolved and lock contention is the primary cause. Rolling back the blocker releases the lock and preserves unrelated transactions.
